title: paeonia arietina var. orientalis
intro: Paeonia arietina var. orientalis, commonly known as the oriental peony, is a plant species belonging to the Paeoniaceae family. It is prized for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving sleep quality, and alleviating symptoms of menopausal hot flashes. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to act as an antispasmodic, anxiolytic, and sedative, making it a popular natural remedy for anxiety, insomnia, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Paeonia arietina var. orientalis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
